title: Second shelf and loving them both!
text: Second shelf and loving them both!. This is the second shelf I purchased in less than  weeks and I'm loving both of them! They have ZERO assembly (other then attaching the feet) and they hold quite a bit of weight. Great for small spaces where you need to get stuff organized and off the floor or scattered around a room, I highly recommend!
